description:
PR #16 review finding 4: https://github.com/jat10/zaq/pull/16
Reviewed head: 1b2637d9a5284ad7ed3febd9d175288f9dfc6897.

Problem
FileDeliverySettings uses DesignSystem.Input.input for numeric controls but renders validation errors in separate manual paragraphs instead of passing the existing errors attribute. Additional manual paragraphs render failure-policy and root file-settings errors. This duplicates existing DesignSystem.FieldHint presentation, bypasses Input error styling, and leaves normal hints visible alongside validation errors instead of applying the shared hint-suppression behavior.
Evidence: lib/zaq_web/components/file_delivery_settings.ex (reviewed lines 103-133 and 143-157), lib/zaq_web/components/design_system/input.ex, and lib/zaq_web/components/design_system/field_hint.ex. This is a low-priority reuse/consistency improvement, not a persistence defect. The shared FileDeliverySettings composition itself is justified and should remain.

Agreed direction / reuse assessment
Reuse Input.input(errors: ...) for numeric-field errors and FieldHint.field_messages for standalone policy/root errors. Preserve the current input-to-error accessible association and aria-invalid behavior. Inspect existing shared ID support first; if necessary, extend the shared component minimally to support error IDs rather than dropping aria-describedby or inventing another error component. Omit nil errors and preserve all existing error messages. Do not duplicate markup, introduce new business Actions/endpoints, or change validation/persistence contracts. Action reuse is not applicable to executable domain operations: this task changes only presentation using existing components.

Acceptance criteria
- Numeric field errors use the existing Input error contract, including standard error styling and normal hint suppression while errors are present.
- Policy/root errors reuse the shared FieldHint rendering where compatible; no parallel file-specific error renderer remains without a concrete documented reason.
- Each errored numeric input retains a valid accessible reference to its rendered error; IDs remain unique across editors and fields. Preserve aria-invalid and required-state semantics.
- Error keys/messages, form names/values, draft retention, capability-driven field visibility and save behavior remain unchanged.
- Extend existing file-settings/component test cases with assertions for shared error rendering, hint suppression and accessible references. Retain existing error assertions and avoid duplicate fixture setup/new test modules unless justified.
- User agreed to this presentation change and issue creation. Follow the existing-test behavior gate for any further changes to test contracts; do not weaken assertions to accommodate implementation.
- Run mix q and isolated relevant component/LiveView tests through Context Mode. Follow parent UX/E2E and final-validation gates. No commits, pushes, merges or restart of previously deferred final precommit are authorized by this issue.

Agent handoff
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md, docs/code-quality.md, docs/conventions.md, docs/testing-approach.md and docs/action-reuse.md. Inspect existing Input/FieldHint implementations and relevant Storybook contracts before editing; keep any shared-component extension backward compatible. Read docs/documentation.md before changing docs/comments. Scope work to finding 4; findings 1-3 are tracked as zaq-h2i.3.15, zaq-h2i.3.16 and zaq-h2i.3.17. User requested issue creation only in this turn; no implementation or agent delegation was performed.
